card.name: Place names starting a city
card.fires_on: The first piece of a city name, mostly "New" before York, in citations giving a publisher's place or in lists of cities. Also the start of other place names such as Pad(ua), NW before Washington, and München.

card.plain: It marks the first word of a city name such as New York, especially where a book citation gives its place of publication.
